thread:
alex (finance): QuotaSight quote review 64 their SKU table mixes per-token, per-request, and a session-tier. Before I route PO to finance ops, can procurement/eng list clarifying q's?
vijay (procurement): I saw potential overlap between TELEMETRY and REQ lines. Need canonical mapping to our buckets: sync gen, streaming chat, embeddings batch. Also require net terms and dispute window.
sophia (eng-ml): Their docs say 'per-request or per-segment' for streaming  ambiguous. If they bill tokens + session/segment we could be double billed. Please paste SKU snippet.
alex (finance): Redacted SKU snippet:
```
SKU,Unit,Price,Notes
QS-TOK,token,0.00045,per-token
QS-EMB,embedding,0.0020,per-embedding-unit
QS-REQ,request,0.00009,api request/ingress
QS-SEG,segment,0.005,per-stream-segment
QS-RES,monthly,1800,reserved credits + discount
```
sophia (eng-ml): OK  need explicit examples showing math for: simple completion (300 tokens out), streaming chat (12 messages, streaming enabled, avg 70 tokens out/message), and batch embeddings (120k units). Show invoice lines and the CSV row that would produce them.
michelle (legal): Contract asks: 30-day dispute window (their default is 10 days), right to audit usage logs, and explicit currency/VAT handling. Also require auditable overage math.
darren (security): Security questions: do telemetry logs include full prompt/response? retention defaults? Can they redact or KMS-encrypt logs? Where are logs hosted (US/EU)?
vijay (procurement): Action items I'll send to AE: 1) canonical SKU mapping matched to our 3 consumption patterns, 2) worked examples with line-by-line invoice math, 3) sample invoice PDF + CSV export schema, 4) proration rules and reserved credit rollover, 5) net-30 & VAT handling, 6) SOC2 and SSO/KMS confirmations. Prioritize SKU mapping, CSV exports, and SOC2 as high.
sophia (eng-ml): Also request raw daily BigQuery export with columns: request_id, utc_ts, model, token_in, token_out, embedding_units, session_id, sku_applied, cost_cents. We need that for automated reconciliation.
quotasight-bot: QuotaSight AE: "Thanks everyone  we'll provide the canonical SKU mapping and three worked examples, attach a sample invoice PDF and CSV export, confirm net-30 and 30-day dispute, SOC2 Type II, SAML, and optional KMS for logs. For streaming: QS-SEG applies only when streaming flag=true; for reserved accounts we can disable QS-SEG. Proration supported for mid-cycle upgrades; reserved credits roll up to 2 months. We'll attach samples in follow-up"
vijay (procurement): Great. I'll consolidate and send. Suggest high: SKU mapping + BigQuery export + sample invoice. Medium: proration & dispute window. Low: residency if they can provide later.
michelle (legal): I'll prepare redline language for audit/dispute and share once we have sample invoice.
darren (security): I'll verify KMS scope and whether redaction can be applied before logs are persisted.
alex (finance): Thanks  ping me when consolidated and I'll approve sending to AE. :thumbsup:
